excluded: sluice-p5-human-smoke-fast and sluice-p5-human-gpu-fast: injected replacement left smokeDriver disconnected; invalid performance results. Rebuilt production bundle measurements supersede these.
sluice-p5-human-gpu-trace: original trace transfer failed. An 8-second stream capture succeeded but heavy trace overhead excludes it from performance comparisons.
Premultiplied transparency: failed composite image comparison, not shipped.
CPU mask backing and opaque main canvas: slower in the diagnostic route, not shipped.
Fixed padded water mask: 37 pixel checks were exact and resizing stopped, but hitch timing did not improve; not shipped.

Clear-free display candidate: isolated 16.5-18 ms CPU frames persisted, so the final version retains the original explicit framebuffer clear. The final profiler-off capture had an 8.2 ms maximum, equal to its baseline.

verification.movingBoundary: Absolute retention assertion fails on baseline 4ae845d and release under Windows D3D11. Added moving-boundary baseline pixel comparisons instead; original assertion was not relaxed.
